description: Non-caching web proxy with advanced filtering: removes ads and trackers, rewrites pages and HTTP headers, controls access.
notes: Privoxy listens on 127.0.0.1:8118. Point the browser or the system proxy there,
then open http://config.privoxy.org/ to check that it works.
config.txt, trust.txt, user.action and user.filter are kept in $persist_dir and survive updates.
Since 4.1.0 the default config logs only fatal errors, and remote toggling
and editing actions from the web interface are off; see the 'debug' and
'enable-*' sections of config.txt to change that.
